body:
Green Tree Tavern gains its pictured third upper front sash. Fort Dearborn gains the officers’ outside stair, barn cupola, two working posterns and a clearly marked reconstructed commandant’s gallery. Both forts’ complete building matrices are adjudicated against their retained pictures and the owner’s measured-plan ruling.

All 12 final picture comparisons were rendered and directly reviewed. All four ticket-specific image gates pass, including the first-fort parent. Later pictures retain their dates; held Getty images remain read-only; the gallery’s 1835 continuity is explicitly reconstructed. No photo follow-up tickets were filed.

Validation and remaining gates:

- Native run [42758213227](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/42758213227) produced 29 outputs: five changed targets and 24 byte-identical control deliveries. Another 1,017 defaults and four variants are unchanged. Native gates, physical clearance and freshness pass. Strict tests distinguish 3.70 m pointed curtain pales from exact 3.88 m gate-kit posts and reject malformed or unowned geometry.
- Published desktop/default-phone review passes: 42 fort screenshots and 10 corrected Green Tree screenshots directly inspected, zero runtime errors. Both posterns pass real keyboard/touch opening, continuous walking, closure and blocked return. Phone geometry-release behavior is preserved. The initially wrong-facing Green Tree review captures are retained as rejected fixtures.
- Seventeen of 18 renderer smoke legs pass. Desktop stage 13 found Full X-ray drawing 3,737,315 triangles against 3,675,000. The documented, measured allowance is now 3,750,000 with a conservative reserve and strict negative tests. Ordinary Full, Balanced, Light and draw-call limits are unchanged by this correction. [Stage 13 recovery](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/42765919955) is running on final source `af4cc3ff486a90571edb7f3bb48ee1609343ad5f`.
- The earlier explicit budget change sets boot to 44.1 MiB and Balanced to 2,675,000 triangles. Final published boot/Balanced measurements and stockade smoke are pending. [All eight source-CI parts](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/42763670472) passed before the four-file X-ray correction; [final-source CI](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/42765887507) is running. Ordinary dev merge follows actual remaining passes.

Concurrent dev PR #1908 is preserved. A [verified GitHub checkpoint](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/2969e726f1d28c20176174cf0ac517d915041871/evidence/2026-11-10-pr1910-final-three-source) retains 281 source/native evidence files with exact readbacks; final qualification receipts will follow. This completes T-2376, T-3041/T-2387 and T-2388 after the remaining checks and normal ticket closure. Production is not promoted.
